capability.summary: Extract structured headers and rows from pipe tables in one local Markdown file
capability.description: Parses a UTF-8 Markdown file with markdown-it-py's CommonMark parser and table rule, returning each recognized pipe table as header and body-row arrays in a JSON envelope.
capability.problem_space: Deterministic structural extraction of GitHub-style pipe tables from a local Markdown file; not Markdown rendering, spreadsheet analysis, OCR, HTML-table scraping, or natural-language interpretation of cell values.

constraint.io_signature: Input: required file_path string naming an existing UTF-8 Markdown file. Output: JSON envelope {status, tool, target, table_count, tables}, where each table contains headers and rows arrays.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8 Markdown file containing zero or more pipe tables recognized by markdown-it-py's table rule
constraint.output_shape: Success: {status: "success", tool: "markdown-it-py", target: string, table_count: integer, tables: [{headers: string[][], rows: string[][]}]}. Missing file exits 2 with an error envelope; read, decoding, or parser failures exit 1 with an error envelope.
limitations: extracts only Markdown pipe tables recognized by the enabled markdown-it-py table rule
does not execute Markdown, interpret cell semantics, infer data types, scrape HTML tables, or write output files
loads the complete input file and parsed result into memory

input_contract.name: file_path
input_contract.description: Path to an existing UTF-8 Markdown file.

output_contract.description: Structured Markdown tables containing header and body-row cell arrays.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: extract tables from a Markdown file
parse Markdown pipe-table headers and rows
turn Markdown tables into structured JSON
negative_intents: extract tables from PDF images or web pages
analyze spreadsheet formulas or infer table semantics
